description: This Dart source file defines a helper class 'MaterialTheme' for managing Material color schemes and theme data for a Flutter application. It provides various predefined color schemes and a method to generate ThemeData based on these schemes, as well as auxiliary classes for extended color information.

classes.name: MaterialTheme
classes.description: Helper class for creating and managing Material themes, color schemes, and text themes for a Flutter app.

classes.name: ExtendedColor
classes.description: Represents an extended color with various contrast and scheme variants.

classes.name: ColorFamily
classes.description: Encapsulates a color and its contrasting or related container colors.

methods.name: lightScheme
methods.description: Returns a light color scheme with specific color values.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured with the light color scheme.

methods.name: lightMediumContrast
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData configured with the medium contrast light scheme.

methods.name: lightHighContrast
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData with a high contrast light scheme.

methods.name: dark
methods.description: Returns ThemeData configured with dark scheme.

methods.name: darkMediumContrast
methods.description: Provides a medium contrast dark color scheme.

methods.name: darkHighContrast
methods.description: Provides a high contrast dark color scheme.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Generates a ThemeData object based on a provided ColorScheme.
